newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five Brazilian children die in Sao Paulo mudslide.
newsitem.headline: Five Brazilian children die in Sao Paulo mudslide.

text.p: Five Brazilian children were killed and five adults injured on Monday when heavy rains caused a hillside to collapse and bury their homes in an eastern Sao Paulo slum, police said.
"Those who died, all children, were buried by the slide," a police spokesman told Reuters. The children ranged in age from one to 11.
TV footage showed rescue workers carrying bodies away from the scene of the slide and cordoning off the area.
The slide, in Sao Paulo's Sapopemba district, occurred at 4 p.m. (1800 GMT) as the city was being lashed with torrential rainfall which also flooded roads and blocked traffic.
